notes.title: Patch 0.9.3 - September 29, 2023
notes.content:
Commanders, we have a fresh new update for Survivor Mercs. "Thank you!" to everyone who helped us find and fix some issues and adjust the balancing for the progression a bit more.

We are already working on more languages - which one do you want to see next? 

Of course we continue with further improvements, but we now focus more our first major update. Stay tuned for the upcoming announcements and keep the feedback coming via the Steam forums and our [url=https://discord.com/invite/nWQVgDNErd]Discord server[/url]! 

[list]
[*] Replaced the font with a more readable one that supports a wider array of languages.
[*] Added translations for Chinese (simplified) and Chinese (traditional).
[*] Fixed an issue where "Quaker" Commanders no longer dealt damage.
[*] Added and fixed many instances of missing sound FX.
[*] Fixed the Boss arenas still not clearing the area reliably, potentially causing issues that warp you or the Boss out of the arena.

[h3]Known Issues[/h3]

Lock, load, and loot, Commanders!

notes.title: Last chance to play the demo!
notes.content:
Commanders, this is your last chance to play the Survivor Mercs demo over the upcoming weekend!

We are extremely grateful for all the input, feedback, and insights we received from all our demo players. 

We chose to take the demo offline - for now - on Monday, August 7, 2023, to focus on improving the game and preparing for the Early Access launch.

The announcement for the EA release date will be coming soon!

The demo helped us a lot to create awareness for our game, make well-informed design decisions, and guide us in our development efforts for the current and upcoming features. We are currently working on improving the system around Commander Traits & cloning, re-balanced a lot of the Mercs and Gear, and are finishing up the work on performance improvements and meta-progression, e.g. building your Bunker HQ, unlocking new stuff via Missions, playing different maps with different bosses, and much more.

Thus, the demo no longer really represents the game as it will come to Early Access.

Will there be a new demo? We don't know, yet.

Are we running another playtest? Most likely, but only with a selected group of playtesters. If you want in, [url=https://discord.gg/RvPGefyAnY]join our Discord server[/url] to stay in the loop.

If you are a streamer or creator who wanted to preview the game, get in touch with us on [url=https://discord.gg/RvPGefyAnY]our Discord server[/url]. We have exciting plans and are happy to add you to our mailing list to let you know when the next chance to play and feature the game is coming.

Lock, load, and loot, Commanders!

notes.title: Big Demo Update - July 19, 2023
notes.content:
First of all, thanks a lot to all our Commanders who provided valuable insights, feedback, and who reported bugs and issues in the Steam forums, on Youtube and Twitch, and on [url=https://discord.gg/RvPGefyAnY]our Discord server[/url].

We are extremely grateful to see so many people care about our game. So we do our best to improve it based on your feedback, and this is our first major update for the demo, with more to come!

[h2]Major UI Improvements[/h2]
We continuously work on the UI and HUD to make the game more beautiful and self-explanatory.

You can now check the Merc's skill trees in the Pause menu during a run or in the Barracks when inspecting your Merc roster. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43630847/f88dbe5032ba8415eee4fd2c2ecc859d2db77ff7.jpg[/img]

This is a very early implementation and it is still in development. We will improve the visuals and usability in future updates. But we already believe that this helps a lot in planning your squad build and level-ups.

Additionally, we made all menus look nicer by adding more animations and details, as well as fixing issues with navigation and how information is presented.

The Pause menu now shows your current Commander, Mercs and Gear. You can make better decisions for your squad build and see the effects that upgrades will have on your squad.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43630847/0471d85aa9bf461418a581ff8935babb83226cb8.jpg[/img]


[h2]New Commander Cloning[/h2]
Cloning a new Commander now works more like we intend it to do.

The average, basic Commander is now only appearing for your first run. After that, all Commander clones are randomized with the Traits you have unlocked from the Genome Lab.
You get two free Commander clones before every run. After that, the DNA cost for additional clones increases with every clone.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43630847/36111cd58c4c4746ca0744cc5aad8f56c269e426.gif[/img]

[b]Be aware that clones will not be saved! [/b]
Once you pick your Commander for the next Operation, all the other clones will be "discreetly discarded".

Surviving Commanders will be available for the next Operation, but they will also be discarded if you choose another one. Commanders that are KIA can be revived for DNA. All your previous fallen Commanders are stored, so you can revive multiple dead clones - if you have the DNA for it. 

The Commander cloning will receive additional updates which are currently in development. With these, you will be able to have more control over which Commanders you want to play, e.g. by pre-defining certain Traits.


[h2]Balancing Adjustments[/h2]
We saw that a lot of you really disliked the penalty for extraction, so we removed it! The amount of Blood Diamonds and DNA you will find was adjusted a bit to keep it balanced with the unlocking prices.

This is an intermediary change, as we are working on a more complex loot & inventory system with different materials that you will need for building more bunker rooms. Also, we're working on changes to how Traits are unlocked, so stay tuned for future updates.

You can now also upgrade the Treasury with fewer Blood Diamonds and up to a 75% saving of your unspent Blood Diamonds. 


[h2]Visuals Improvements[/h2]
We adjusted some of the rendering effects for Traits like "nostalgic" and "colorblind". They appear now less extreme. We also improved some graphical assets and effects in some areas like the objectives.


[h2]General Fixes and Optimizations[/h2]
[list]
[*] "Survivor Bonus" is now only shown in the end-of-run screen if you get a bonus level for a Merc.
[*] When recruiting a Merc with a "Survivor Bonus", the free level-ups are now titled accordingly to help you differentiate them from regular level-ups.
[*] Reduced default volume for all audio to save the ears of headphone users.
[*] Adjusted the sandbags around the objective sentries to reduce the probability of Mercs getting stuck.
[*] Added an option to adjust the settings in the Pause menu.
[*] All Mercs are now extracting as intended. No one is left behind!
[*] Fixed various localization strings for EN and DE.
[*] Fixed multiple smaller UI glitches.
[*] The Commander is invulnerable for a bit longer after capturing objectives.
[*] Fixed the scale of Commanders in the Clone Bay and other menus in very high or very low resolutions.
[*] Reduced flickering in some UI elements.
[*] Fixed a bug that healed your Commander randomly after pausing the game.
[*] Defender shield can now be aimed freely and is no longer axis-aligned.
[*] Fixed an instance where the Extraction Point would not trigger after capturing it.
[*] Made vampiric aura and some other effects more transparent for better visibility.
[*] Slightly improved rendering performance of particle effects.
[*] Added shadow proxies for all enemies and Mercs to improve rendering performance.
[*] Fixed an instance where you could start with a Merc from a previous operation.
[*] Fixed an issue where your Commander could be glitched out of bounds.
[*] Added V-Sync and frame limiter settings
[/list]


[h2]What's next?[/h2]
We are already working on the next update for the game which will also go into the demo. Our main priority is [b]performance improvements[/b]. We made great progress over the last weeks and are already seeing good results. But we didn't want to delay this update while we're wrapping up development and testing on the performance improvements. Thanks for your patience and for giving us some more time to make it good!

As always, we are looking forward to hearing your feedback on our Discord server, or here in the Steam forums.


Lock, load, and loot, Commanders!

notes.title: Survivor Mercs Public Playtest Weekend #3 Happening Now!
notes.content:
[b]Commanders, the 3rd Public Playtest Weekend for Survivor Mercs is happening now![/b]

We are looking for your feedback to further improve the game. The past weeks were quite busy as we reworked and improved some core systems. This helped us improve performance already and will allow us even more improvements in the future - to hit that sweet, sweet stable 60 fps.

Here's your operations briefing of what to expect:

[h2]NEW: View Range[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43630847/bb3d1491b6a6b483deb958dc73d587becae6938e.gif[/img]

We received a lot of comments about the Commander Traits with visual impairment. After careful consideration, we decided to retire some of these effects, as some of you suffered from nausea and generally had a bad experience with them.

Instead, we are introducing a fog-of-war / view range feature. Your Commanders have different view ranges and might even get specific view patterns in the future. Your Mercs also extend your view range slightly. This feature is still a very early version of what we imagine it to be. And we did not yet fully retire all other visual impairment Traits. 

Expect it to become visually more polished in the future and actually have a more dramatic impact on the gameplay, e.g. by influencing how some of your Mercs perform or select their targets.


[h2]NEW: Merc Skill Trees[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43630847/e97bcc07af39866f00280a346f89a3d6417b444d.gif[/img]

The second big feature are skill trees for your Mercs. 

You can now select between different skill lanes that you can level-up individually. This will allow you to build your squad into a certain direction during each operation. Some skill lanes are exclusive to each other, e.g. Shredder can load slug or buckshot ammunition. Other skill lanes might have prerequisites to open them up, e.g. Curveball can throw more grenades after you increase his Arm Training skill to a certain level.

Please note that the skill trees are not yet visualized. We are currently working on displaying them in the Barracks. But we didn't want to wait any longer to receive your feedback and see the squad builds you come up with.

[h2]Other Improvements[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43630847/e3ad77f7ebb8c7fb51565f6272b3b0351d5745d4.jpg[/img]

You will note that the Commander Selection Menu has an improved navigation and is less confusing. You can now also revive your last fallen Commander with DNA or select up to 3 new, randomly generated clones. More features and improvements for this are already in development.

The Extraction Point is now available after you drop below 50% of your HP or after 4 minutes into the operation. But beware! Calling it in will alert the enemy and send some elite forces your way.

You will no longer receive Gear just from level-ups. Now you have to capture Beacon Objectives to call-in new Mercs or new Gear! But you can get some generic upgrades from a level-up that will increase your overall Commander's and squad's combat capacity.

Mercs receive a Survivor Bonus if they are at least level 10 when you extract, or when you defeat the final Boss. Each bonus grants a free level-up for one of their skills once you call them in.

You will discover a lot more new and improved things, and even if we fixed a ton of bugs, you might encounter some completely fresh ones! 

The game's balancing is also a bit more on the difficult side of things at the moment. This is a constant, ongoing process but it is a deliberate choice since there are some features on the horizon, mainly Bunker upgrades and new content that will impact the balancing a lot. 

[b]We are looking forward to receiving your feedback [b][url=https://discord.gg/RvPGefyAnY]on our Discord server[/url][/b] and are forever grateful for your support in making Survivor Mercs better and better![/b]

Now lock, load and loot, Commanders! Join the playtest on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2141520/Survivor_Mercs]Steam page of Survivor Mercs[/url].

[b]Note:[/b] if you participated in the playtest before, please delete your savegame to prevent problems or hiccups with the new content and features.

notes.title: Survivor Mercs 1st Showcase @ GG.Bavaria & Playtest Plans
notes.content:
[b]We did it! [/b]We showed the game for the first time to the public! 
And now we're confident to show it to even more people.

[h1]THE EVENT[/h1]

[b]GG.Bavaria[/b] is a local games culture event in Munich, our local Wolpertinger home base, which happened over the course of the last weekend. 

We set up our operations in the first floor of the venue with a good vantage point. And the unsuspecting target subjects were lured directly into our ambush!

The game ran smoothly and caught the audience's attention quite early. Occupying a neuralgic choke point allowed us to recruit nearly all players passing our position.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43630847/0707132becfcb6af95b6a738f39330dadff8c7cf.jpg[/img]

[h3]STEAM DECK[/h3]
In a cloak-and-dagger operation we deployed Survivor Mercs onto [b]SteamDeck[/b]. Lo-and-behold, the game ran without any major issues. This immediately tripled our effectiveness.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43630847/d3f0579516e0236ddd8060089a13424e4e50f96e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43630847/3f0d72f25d52f878b0728595fb9ca026bd425446.jpg[/img]

/cringe mode off


Thanks to all the playtesters who tried Survivor Mercs on the weekend. We received amazing and insightful feedback into the core mechanics of the game. And it is fun!

We demo'ed the basic game runs without the progression and unlock systems. You were able to play with a variety of randomized Commanders and a broad selection of Mercs and Gears to try and survive a 20-minute-run until you would face our first boss.

Our players already created very interesting squad builds to try and survive the enemy hordes, made up of different enemy waves with varying attack patterns. The testers were already hunting for the objectives on the map to grab as much loot as possible, and many figured out how to extract successfully before falling victim to the final onslaught.


[h1]THE AFTERMATH[/h1]

With around 100 sessions played and close to 20 survey participants we already had some first data to look into what the players liked and what they want to see improved.

[h3]CLOSED PLAYTEST[/h3]
Since we received a lot of very positive feedback, we decided to change our plans and host a first [b]closed playtest[/b] already in the [b]very near future[/b]. 

For this we invite everyone who is interested in participating, to join our Discord server. We will be organizing the playtest there and grant access to everyone who wants to participate and provide feedback.
